text.en: My wagon came in a pin short and held together out of spite. Three pins in the grass between the lane and the corral — find them and the next wagon that leaves owes you. Road pays, warden. Ask anyone.
text.id: Wagonku datang kurang satu paku dan bertahan utuh karena keberuntungan. Tiga paku di rumput antara lajur dan kandang — temukan dan wagon berikutnya berhutang padamu. Jalan selalu membayar, warden. Tanya siapa saja.
